channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Company of Heroes 3: Hammer & Shield Battlegroup DLC
item.description: This content requires the base game Company of Heroes 3 on Steam in order to play.

item.title: Galacticare
item.description: Build, manage and optimise intergalactic hospitals! Recruit staff to satisfy the whims of various alien species, and cure their bizarre illnesses - for money! Save the (literal) Galaxy in story mode, or head into sandbox to design the hospital of your dreams.

item.title: Gold Mining Simulator - Definitive Edition
item.description: Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the ultimate version of the game, featuring all previously released expansions plus new content, gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and numerous quality of life upgrades for the most complete gold mining experience.

item.title: Horsey Game
item.description: Collect Horses. Breed Horses. Race Horses. Genetically Modify Horses. Create a Horse paradise or just get rich!

item.title: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia
item.description: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia is a satirical action-adventure, brought to life by a twisted and wicked tale. Featuring hard but fair combat, *full character customization, unique battle armor and engaging narrative mechanics rich in lore, Nostalgaia plunges you into almost certain death at every turn.

item.title: Wallpaper Animator
item.description: Use animated wallpapers on your desktop. Explore unlimited live wallpapers from the community, or create your own with included AI generations that refill daily.

item.title: Legion TD 2 - Floating Isles Campaign
item.description: A 10-15 hour singleplayer/co-operative campaign playable with 1-4 players.

item.title: Arctic Awakening
item.description: A first-person narrative adventure set in the unforgiving Arctic. Your plane crashed in a storm, leaving only your court-mandated therapy bot for company as you journey to find your co-pilot and uncover the mysteries buried beneath the ice.
